Subject: Post-demo recap + MAP (draft v1) and next steps

Hi Amy / Tom —

Thanks again for the demo earlier today. Quick recap and an initial Mutual Action Plan (attached) so we can align milestones and owners. Things I captured on the call:

- Primary win criteria: reduce inference latency 30% and cut per-token cost by ~40% for your customer-facing assistant.
- Technical scope: integrate Redwood Hosted API for pilot (subset of traffic), then Dedicated capacity for scale.
- Key dependencies: legal T&Cs, security questionnaire, infra access for staging, performance runbook.

Attached: redwood-MAP-draft-v1.xlsx (milestones, proposed owners, tentative dates).

Proposed immediate next steps:
1) You confirm governance owners (economic buyer, security owner, legal owner, engineering lead).
2) We lock milestone dates for pilot (target pilot start: 2027-01-18).
3) DataSynth shares SOC2/security contact and any procurement timelines.

Can you confirm owners and any blockers by EOD Friday (12/17)? I’ll update the MAP and circulate a version with explicit acceptance items for signatures.

Best,
Sean Gallagher
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Mobile: +1 415-555-0193

Sean —

Thanks for the clear recap and the MAP draft. We reviewed it this morning with Tom and a couple of notes:

- Economic buyer: Tom Reynolds (CPO) — will own final commercial sign-off.
- Security owner: assigning to me for now; I’ll loop in our InfoSec lead (name and email below) by 12/18.
- Legal owner: procurement@datasynth.com (they handle boilerplate and SOW).
- Engineering lead: Miguel Torres (miguel.torres@datasynth.com) — he’ll own staging access and performance validation.

Questions/blocks:
- Procurement needs a high-level T&C summary and an estimate for committed throughput (tokens/day) to size Dedicated capacity. Can you add a line in the MAP with committed token estimate ranges?
- Security questionnaire: we can share our template but will need Redwood’s SOC 2 or equivalent evidence.

We can confirm owners formally once I’ve looped InfoSec. Pilot start of 2027-01-18 looks achievable if legal and security turn quickly.

—Amy
Amy Davies
Director, Platform Partnerships | DataSynth Inc
amy.davies@datasynth.com
